course.title: Electronic, Magnetic and Optical Properties of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Demonstrate that the first derivative of E with respect to K is related to the velocity and the second(17) derivative is related to the mass, of a free electron. Use these results, explain the concept of effective mass and prove that the effective mass of an electron near the top of the valence band in negative.
